scope.design: Retrospective, single-club illustration using the existing saved simulation.
scope.generalization: Does not establish effects for other clubs, origins, or seasons.

units.probabilities_and_contrasts: Probability units (0-1); multiply by 100 for percentage points.

definitions.ratio_is_positive_upside_threshold: Only when U > 0 does a/b > D/U imply positive survival change for b > 0.

uncertainty.component_variance: Var(q_r) = q_r*(1-q_r)/n_r, conditional on category counts.
uncertainty.component_and_contrast_intervals: Approximate normal intervals; not clipped to admissible bounds.
uncertainty.ratio_interval: Fieller confidence set from the correlated normal approximation for (D,U).
uncertainty.ratio_interval_encoding: ratio_mc_ci_intervals is JSON; null lower/upper endpoint means negative/positive infinity. Empty array with status undefined differs from status empty. Low/high columns represent a single interval only.
uncertainty.includes: Monte Carlo sampling error conditional on fitted forecasts and category counts only.
uncertainty.excludes: Model-estimation, model-specification, future-state and causal-intervention uncertainty.
uncertainty.boundary_warning: Binomial plug-in normal approximations can be unreliable with sparse counts or q near 0/1; q exactly 0/1 yields zero estimated variance, not proof of certainty.
uncertainty.rank_warning: Ranks are descriptive point-estimate orderings, with no multiplicity correction or joint rank inference. Fixtures share simulated seasons.

scenario.baseline_probabilities: Empirical n_r/(n_win+n_draw+n_loss) from the input CSV.
scenario.feasibility: a+b <= empirical draw probability; infeasible rows suppress scenario effects.
scenario.uncertainty_scope: Fixed probability transfers; empirical outcome-frequency uncertainty is not propagated.

assumptions: The simulator uses independent fixtures and frozen fitted parameters.
Hypothetical reweighting preserves scoreline distributions conditional on W/D/L.
All other fixtures, league rules and the playoff model remain fixed.
No feasible tactical, lineup, rotation or in-game intervention is estimated.
These consequences do not identify the causal value of a league point or a player.
